name: knowledge-publishing-system
description: Publication prep and validation for the Obsidian -> Quarto -> Quartz pipeline.

scripts.render: cd vault && uv run quarto render --profile publish
scripts.preview: cd vault && uv run quarto preview --profile preview
scripts.pre-build: npm run design-tokens -- --check && npm run prepare-publication && npm run render && npm run prepare-publication -- --require-quarto
scripts.build: npm run pre-build && npm run site
scripts.build-serve: npm run pre-build && npm run serve
scripts.validate: npm run fixtures && for v in scripts/validate-*.sh; do echo "--- $v"; "$v" || exit 1; done
scripts.site-fast: npm run prepare-publication -- --keep-quarto && npm run site
scripts.fixtures: npm run prepare-publication -- --fixtures && cd vault && uv run quarto render --profile fixtures && cd .. && npm run prepare-publication -- --fixtures --require-quarto && cd site && QUARTO_ARTIFACTS=../generated/fixture-quarto node quartz/bootstrap-cli.mjs build --directory fixture-content --output ../generated/fixture-site
